name: Shared components
summary: The registry of house a11y and responsive primitives an agent must reach for instead of rolling its own — field errors, live-region announcements, the accessible progress bar, the useIsMobile() shape switch, the full-page error, empty states and loading skeletons.
highlights: Registry of house accessibility and responsive primitives
Reach for these instead of rolling your own
Field errors, live regions, progress bar, useIsMobile(), error page, empty states, skeletons
lead: A fresh-but-correct reimplementation of an error node, a live region or a progress bar still fragments the system: it drops the ARIA wiring, the canonical breakpoint and the house copy the primitive already encodes. This pattern is the lookup table — for each need, the DS primitive to reuse and the contract it keeps — and binds each rule to a binary criterion (anti-slop/criteria.json → surfaces.shared-components) a consumer self-judges.

skillRef.note: Seeded from the aha-design plugin v1.80.0 (aha-design-shared-components + its -judge). The DS now SHIPS every primitive that skill registered — <aha-field-error>, <aha-live-region>, <aha-progressbar>, useIsMobile() / <aha-viewport-switch>, <aha-error-page> — so the registry resolves to real DS exports instead of plugin-only React components. The judge criteria C1..C4 live in anti-slop/criteria.json.

surfaceChoice.useFor: one field failed validation — <aha-field-error> (variant="respondent" in respondent renderers)
a change a screen-reader user would otherwise miss — one mounted <aha-live-region>
progress that must be announced — <aha-progressbar> with a label
a render that changes SHAPE below 768px — useIsMobile() / <aha-viewport-switch>
the whole page cannot render — <aha-error-page code>
nothing failed, there is simply no content yet — <aha-empty>
content is loading — <aha-skeleton> blocks mirroring the real layout
surfaceChoice.example: a list of rows while fetching

composedOf.use: the one error node a field describes itself with — form variant (a11y FieldError) or respondent variant (FieldErrorDisplay)
the DS field: status="error" sets aria-invalid and its aria-describedby is forwarded to the inner input
screen-reader announcements — assertive + atomic, mounted even when empty, no role=alert
accessible progress — role=progressbar + aria-valuenow/min/max + aria-label over the DS Progress
the visual bar <aha-progressbar> draws; alone only for a decorative bar beside its own numbers
the useIsMobile() shape switch — the React hook, the ./viewport store, or <aha-viewport-switch> in HTML
full-page errors — code → DS Result + British-English copy, role=alert, error-page-view telemetry
the empty state — says what is missing and offers one next step
loading placeholders that mirror the real layout, inside a role=status aria-busy container
the state layout <aha-error-page> composes; use directly for an in-page action outcome

componentBacklog: None — every primitive the `shared-components` guide registry names now ships here.

rules.rule: Meet every registry need with its DS primitive — <aha-field-error>, <aha-live-region>, <aha-progressbar>, useIsMobile() / <aha-viewport-switch>, <aha-error-page>, <aha-empty>, <aha-skeleton>. A hand-rolled <div aria-live>, red <span>, width-% bar or bespoke error page fails even when it looks right.
Pick the field-error variant by context: the default form variant (a11y FieldError) in forms, variant="respondent" (FieldErrorDisplay: role=alert, assertive) in respondent element renderers.
The input sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the error's id. A DS <aha-input> does both — status="error" + aria-describedby, which it forwards to its inner field.
Gate a render that changes SHAPE below 768px on useIsMobile() (or <aha-viewport-switch>) — never an ad-hoc useMediaQuery / window.innerWidth check.
Pure styling uses @media (max-width: 767.98px) directly — never the hook, and never 768px / 767px.
Keep one <aha-live-region> mounted (even empty) and announce through it — assertive + atomic, no role=alert, so nothing is missed or read twice.
An announced progress bar is <aha-progressbar> with value/min/max and a label (plus value-text when the raw number is not what a person would say).
A whole-page failure is <aha-error-page code> (role=alert, fires error-page-view for telemetry); an absence of content is <aha-empty>, never an error.
A loading placeholder mirrors the real layout with <aha-skeleton> blocks inside a container carrying role="status" and aria-busy="true" — never a lone spinner or grey box.

Visible text uses the DS text components / AntD Typography, not raw /

; state is never conveyed by colour alone — pair every status colour with text or an ARIA label.

reuseNote: Doc-only pattern — each primitive ships as its own DS component (see composedOf); this page is the registry and the judge criteria.

selfCheck.label: every registry need uses its DS primitive, nothing hand-rolled
right field-error variant; aria-invalid + aria-describedby wired
useIsMobile() for shape only; styling at @media 767.98px
live region / progressbar / skeleton a11y contracts intact; no colour-only state
